```python
import os
import math
import numpy as np

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as viper
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Create the Chrono system
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
# Use Bullet for contacts
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
# Fix the method name: Set_G_acc instead of SetGravitationalAcceleration
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Create SCM deformable terrain instead of a rigid ground box
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.SCMTerrain(system)

# Define the reference plane z=0  (normal = (0,0,1), offset = 0)
terrain.SetPlane(0, 0, 1, 0)

# Soil parameters: (Bekker Kphi, Bekker Kc, exponent n,
#                  cohesion, friction angle, Janosi shear, elastic K, damping R)
terrain.SetSoilParameters(
    2e5,                 # Bekker Kphi
    3e4,                 # Bekker Kc
    1.1,                 # exponent n
    0.0,                 # cohesion
    math.radians(30),    # friction angle
    2e5,                 # Janosi shear modulus
    3e4,                 # elastic stiffness
    0.01                 # viscous damping
)

# Initialize terrain grid: xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, grid spacing
terrain.Initialize(-10, 10, -10, 10, 0.1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Instantiate the Viper rover and its DC‐motor driver
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
rover  = viper.Viper(system)
driver = viper.ViperDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# Initialize rover pose at (0, 0.2, 0) with identity rotation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.2, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
# Fix the call to use ChCoordsysD
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChCoordsysD(init_pos, init_rot))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Set up Irrlicht visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Viper rover – SCM deformable terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 2.5, 1.5),
              chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5),
                       chrono.ChVector3d(0,   0,   0.5),
                       3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Simulation loop
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
time_step = 1e-3

while vis.Run():
    # 5.a) Constant zero steering
    driver.SetSteering(0.0)

    # 5.b) Update rover mechanics
    rover.Update()

    # 5.c) Render
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # 5.d) Advance dynamics
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
```

- Replaced the rigid‐ground box by an `SCMTerrain` object and initialized it over a 20×20 m area with 0.1 m mesh spacing.  
- Called `terrain.SetPlane(...)`, `terrain.SetSoilParameters(...)`, and `terrain.Initialize(...)` instead of manually creating a `ChBodyEasyBox`.  
- Fixed two mismatched PyChrono API calls:  
  • `system.Set_G_acc(…)` instead of the non‐existent `SetGravitationalAcceleration(…)`.  
  • `chrono.ChCoordsysD` instead of the non‐existent `ChFramed`.  
- Removed the time‐varying steering logic in the loop and simply call `driver.SetSteering(0.0)` each time.

Here is a self‐contained Python script that sets up a Chrono::Engine SMC system, adds a rigid terrain, instantiates the Viper rover, and drives its steering from 0 up to a maximum over a fixed ramp time.  It uses Irrlicht for real‐time 3D visualization.  You can copy–paste and run this directly (assuming you have `pychrono` and its vehicle modules installed, and that your `CHRONO_DATA_DIR` environment variable is set so that `chrono.GetChronoDataPath()` finds the vehicle JSON files).

```python
import math
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.viper as viper_mod
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1)  Initialize Chrono system and gravity
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('/path/to/Chrono/data/')   # set this to your Chrono data folder
system = chrono.ChSystemSMC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2)  Create a rigid ground (terrain)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)

# Default material for the terrain patch
patch_mat = veh.RigidTerrain.PatchMaterialData()
patch_mat.mu   = 0.9
patch_mat.cr   = 0.01
patch_mat.Y    = 2e7
patch_mat.cr_mu = 0.3

# Add a single infinite patch at height 0
terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.CSYSNORM, 20, 10)
terrain.Initialize()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3)  Instantiate the Viper rover and set visualization types
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Note: ViperVehicle will look for JSONs in CHRONO_DATA_DIR/vehicle/viper/
viper = viper_mod.ViperVehicle()
viper.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChMaterialSurface.SMC)
viper.SetChassisFixed(False)
viper.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0)))
viper.Initialize()

# Visualization
viper.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
viper.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
viper.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
viper.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
viper.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4)  (Optional)  Create a simple driver that ramps steering over time
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SimpleRampingDriver:
    def __init__(self, max_steering, ramp_time):
        self.max_steer = max_steering
        self.ramp_time = ramp_time
        # constant throttle / braking
        self.throttle = 0.5
        self.braking  = 0.0

    def GetInputs(self, time):
        # linear ramp of steering from 0 to max over ramp_time
        if time < self.ramp_time:
            steer = self.max_steer * time / self.ramp_time
        else:
            steer = self.max_steer
        # DriverInputs takes (steering, throttle, braking)
        return veh.DriverInputs(steer, self.throttle, self.braking)

# Create your driver: ramp steering to 30 degrees (0.52 rad) over 5 seconds
driver = SimpleRampingDriver(max_steering=0.52, ramp_time=5.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5)  Create an Irrlicht application for real-time visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
app = veh.ChVehicleIrrApp(viper,                         # the vehicle object
                          "Viper Rover on Rigid Terrain")  # window title

# Add typical lights, skybox, and attach assets
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddSkyBox()
app.AddLogo()
app.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(-6, 2, 0),
                                      chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0.25, chrono.VECT_Y)))
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()

# Set the step sizes
timestep = 1.0 / 200.0
app.SetTimestep(timestep)
system.SetStep(timestep)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6)  Simulation loop
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
time = 0.0
end_time = 20.0

while app.GetDevice().run() and time < end_time:
    # 1) Get driver inputs for this time
    inputs = driver.GetInputs(time)

    # 2) Synchronize modules
    viper.Synchronize(time, inputs, terrain)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    app.Synchronize("",  # no additional text in title bar
                    {})

    # 3) Render scene
    app.BeginScene()
    app.DrawAll()
    app.EndScene()

    # 4) Advance all modules by one timestep
    driver_inputs = inputs  # not advancing the driver object itself here
    viper.Advance(timestep)
    terrain.Advance(timestep)
    app.Advance(timestep)

    # 5) Increment time
    time += timestep
```

Explanation of the key steps:

1. We initialize a `ChSystemSMC` and set gravity.
2. We build a flat, rigid terrain patch using the `RigidTerrain` helper, setting friction, restitution, etc.
3. We instantiate the Viper rover (`ViperVehicle`) and configure its visualization (mesh for chassis/wheels).
4. We create a minimal driver class that linearly ramps the steering input from 0 to a maximum angle over a given time, holding throttle and brake fixed.
5. We attach an Irrlicht application (`ChVehicleIrrApp`), add lights, skybox, and set a chase camera.
6. In the main loop we:
   a. Query new driver inputs.
   b. Call `Synchronize(...)` on the vehicle, terrain, and application.
   c. Draw the scene.
   d. Advance each module by one timestep.

You can tweak the `max_steering`, `ramp_time`, throttle, braking or other visual and physical parameters to taste.

```python
import os
import math
import numpy as np

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as viper
import pychrono.sensor as sens
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create Chrono system
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
# correct gravity setter
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))

chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create ground body (rigid box)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
ground_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(
    20.0,   # x-length
    20.0,   # y-length
    1.0,    # z-thickness
    1000,   # density
    True,   # visualization?
    True,   # collision?
    ground_mat
)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -1.0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
# apply a concrete texture
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg")
)
system.Add(ground)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create Viper Rover + driver
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
rover = viper.Viper(system)
driver = viper.ViperDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# initial pose: small offset in Y, identity rotation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.2, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
# ChFrameD takes (quat, pos)
initial_frame = chrono.ChFrameD(init_rot, init_pos)
rover.Initialize(initial_frame)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set up Irrlicht visualization
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle("Viper rover - Rigid terrain")
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("logo_pychrono_alpha.png"))
vis.AddSkyBox()
# a fixed “free” camera looking at the scene
vis.AddCamera(
    chrono.ChVector3d(0, 2.5, 1.5),
    chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1)
)
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(
    chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5),
    chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5),
    3, 4, 10, 40, 512
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a Sensor Manager and add a point light for the sensors
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)
intensity = 1.0
# note: in some versions use manager.GetScene().AddPointLight(...)
manager.scene.AddPointLight(
    chrono.ChVector3f(2, 2.5, 100),
    chrono.ChColor(intensity, intensity, intensity),
    500.0
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a third‐person camera sensor on the rover chassis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# define the camera frame relative to the chassis:
# translate (1,0,1.45), pitch down by 0.2 rad about Y
q_pitch = chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(0.2, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))
offset_pose = chrono.ChFrameD(q_pitch, chrono.ChVector3d(1.0, 0, 1.45))

cam = sens.ChCameraSensor(
    rover.GetChassis().GetBody(),  # parent body
    15,                            # update rate [Hz]
    offset_pose,                   # pose in the body frame
    720,                           # image width
    480,                           # image height
    1.408                          # vertical FOV [rad]
)
cam.SetName("Third Person POV")
# push a built‐in OpenGL visualizer for debugging
cam.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualize(720, 480, "Viper Front Camera"))
manager.AddSensor(cam)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
time_step = 1e-3
step_number = 0

# we only want to render at ~25 FPS
render_step_size = 1.0 / 25.0
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / time_step)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main simulation loop
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
while vis.Run():
    # read the Chrono system time
    t = system.GetChTime()

    # simple steering profile
    max_steer = math.pi / 6.0
    steer = 0.0
    if 2.0 < t < 7.0:
        steer = max_steer * (t - 2.0) / 5.0
    elif 7.0 <= t < 12.0:
        steer = max_steer * (12.0 - t) / 5.0

    driver.SetSteering(steer)
    rover.Update()

    # advance the physics
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

    # advance the sensors
    manager.Update()

    # render only every N steps to achieve ~25 FPS
    if (step_number % render_steps) == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

    step_number += 1
```
